paper_title: Constraints on the Coupling between Axionlike Dark Matter and Photons Using an Antiproton Superconducting Tuned Detection Circuit in a Cryogenic Penning Trap
suggested_experiment_name: BASE (antiproton Penning-trap LC resonator ALP search)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 3(a)
notes: BASE Penning-trap experiment at CERN using the superconducting axial detection circuit (resonance ~674.9 kHz) as an LC-circuit haloscope. New measured 95% CL power-constrained limit g_agamma < 1e-11 GeV^-1 over the narrow mass band 2.7906-2.7914 neV, assuming ALPs comprise all local DM with rho = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 and the standard halo model. Detailed limit curve is in Fig. 3(a) (not numerically tabulated); the two points here encode the headline flat limit across the stated mass range. The paper also mentions a projected future sensitivity of 1.5e-11 GeV^-1 over 2-5 neV, which is a projection, not included here. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.6, 31)) | Vision: Coupling type unambiguous (g_agamma vs m_a, axion-photon).
